name: No Labeling / No Design
shortDescription: Clean enclosure without any labels or designs
longDescription: A clean, unmarked enclosure surface. Perfect if you want to add your own labeling later or prefer a minimalist look.

name: Labeled Lettering
longDescription: Basic text labeling for knobs, switches, and jacks. We'll add clear, professional lettering to identify all controls on your pedal. Please specify your desired labels in the order notes.

name: Simple Decal Lettering
longDescription: High-quality vinyl decal lettering for a professional appearance. More durable than basic labeling and available in multiple colors. Specify your text and preferred color in order notes.

name: Customized Decal Graphic
longDescription: Full custom vinyl decal with your own graphic design. You can provide artwork files (vector preferred) or describe your vision. Includes logo, text, and decorative elements as specified.

name: Engraving
longDescription: Laser engraving provides permanent, precise text that won't wear off. Ideal for professional builds or pedals that will see heavy use. Note: Engraving works best on raw aluminum or certain powder-coated finishes. May not be compatible with all enclosure finishes.

name: Relic
longDescription: Professional aging treatment to give your pedal a vintage, road-worn look. Includes intentional scratches, wear patterns, and patina effects. Each relic job is unique. Note: This finish cannot be combined with pristine powder coating or certain metallic finishes. Manual review may be required.
